text:
maria: Heads up — small nightly QA job started failing under runtime pinned to 3.1 in eu-west. It's low traffic but blocks our nightly regression check. link: https://ci.internal/reports/2987
aj: What's the error?
maria: KV cache mismatch + occasional OOM on longseq path. Short repro attached in the CI job logs.
kevin: Unpinning runtime globally worries me for customer traffic. How many requests are we talking?
maria: ~15 req/min during 02:00-03:00 UTC, internal QA only. Not customer-facing.
sara: Can we route it to a dev-only pool instead of changing pins?
maria: Dev pool doesn't exist in eu-west for this test; spin-up takes too long for tonight.
deploybot: pinlist check: model redwood/llama3q-v2 -> pinned to runtime 3.1 in eu-west (policy: global-safe). To request a temporary exemption run:```deploybot override pin-exempt redwood/llama3q-v2 --region eu-west --until 2025-06-01 --reason "nightly-qa"```Note: requires 2 approvals.
aj: I can approve once we add a rollback/playback plan and smoke tests.
kevin: +1 if we limit scope (region eu-west only) and set a canary/internal-only route at 0.1%. Also need telemetry tag.
ops: Rollback commands for quick revert:
```
deploybot pin redwood/llama3q-v2 --region eu-west --runtime 3.1 --reason "revert-exemption"
```
and to unpin (when granting exemption):
```
deploybot unpin redwood/llama3q-v2 --region eu-west --reason "nightly-qa-exempt"
```
maria: I'll open the exemption request with those details and attach smoke script `infra/tests/llama3q-smoke.sh`. Will also add a short telemetry dashboard.
sara: Add an alert: pagerduty:llama3q if error_rate > 1% OR p50 latency > 200ms.
deploybot: exemption request submitted: ID ex-20250601-42. Waiting approvals: aj, kevin.
aj: approved — leaving note: monitor first 60m post-change, automatic pin back at expiry.
kevin: approved — ensure canary routing set to internal-only 0.1% and telemetry tag `exempt-nightly-qa`.
deploybot: Exemption granted until 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z. Auto-pin scheduled at expiry. Telemetry tag applied: exempt-nightly-qa.
maria: Applying change now, will run smoke and report back in 30m.
maria: smoke passed, no regressions in first 30m. Watching for 1h. :thumbsup:
maria: Closing — exemption worked, auto-pin scheduled. Will open a follow-up to investigate longseq KV path regression properly. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
